reference.source: Psychiatry topic map (Marrow e6 topic selection only; text rewritten in own words, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: ADHD needs symptoms in two or more settings before 12
Tourette equals motor plus vocal tics beyond a year
Fragile X is commonest inherited intellectual disability
Stimulant monitoring: pulse, BP, growth, cardiac history
reference.pathophysiology: Atypical synaptic development and connectivity shape social brain, executive and motor circuits early, interacting with genetic syndromes and prenatal exposures; supports alter trajectories more than late cures.
additionalDifferentials: Autism versus social anxiety (developmental reciprocity versus fear)
ADHD versus bipolar mania in youth (chronic trait versus episodes)
Intellectual disability versus specific learning disorder breadth
additionalInvestigations: Multi informant rating scales and developmental history
Hearing, vision, genetic testing (fragile X, microarray) by presentation
Baseline cardiovascular and growth charting for stimulants
